title: Simon Ch. 4, 2.7 and 3.14: stationarity in N ∩ U gives locally bounded generalized mean curvature
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, N an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold with (N̄ ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U with H^n(M ∖ N) = 0 whose varifold v(M, θ) is stationary in N ∩ U (R.IsStationaryAlong N). Then v(M, θ) has a generalized mean curvature H in U (Simon Ch. 4, 3.14): H is μ_V-measurable, bounded on every compact subset of U, and ∫_M θ div_M X dH^n = −∫ X·H dμ_V for every X ∈ C¹_c(U; ℝ^P), μ_V = θH^n⌞M (R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ N) = 0 → R.IsStationaryAlong N → R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature
